identityReviewRetry.reason: Iovysara's frozen central geometry repeats five near neighbors and must also stay distinct from Drenonia's new low-eye broad-nose correction.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native youthful face has large green almond eyes, a compact short rounded nose, full centrally bowed lips and a short rounded chin, with off-centre swept-back ash-brown hair.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Frozen portrait uses medium eyes, a longer fine nose and conventional wide softly bowed mouth shared by Aevurara, Veneranda, Eilidh, Eryurene and Debana.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Increase round vertical eye aperture with wider spacing, shorten the slender bridge to a visibly lifted compact tip, and make the mouth small and centrally plump with a deep bow. Retain short rounded chin and native hair.
